methods.local_metro: estimate: US monthly volume x metro population share (Census V2025 metro pop / US pop 341,784,857); rounded to 2 significant figures. Counts all searches for the service in the metro, not only searches that type this city name.
methods.local_metro_suburb: estimate: US monthly volume x metro population share (Census V2025); the keyword names a suburb, so the value is metro-level demand for the service, not searches typing the suburb name; rounded to 2 significant figures.
methods.local_state: estimate: US monthly volume x state population share (Census V2025 NST-EST2025-POP); rounded to 2 significant figures.
methods.google_ads_equiv: estimate: monthly searches (local value for city/state keywords, US value for national) x industry search-ad CTR (WordStream 2025) x CPC basis (cpc.basis_for_value); rounded to 2 significant figures. Approximate monthly cost of buying the ad clicks these searchers make on Google Ads; not a quote.
methods.value_index: estimate: search value index = monthly searches x CPC basis; an advertiser-value ranking signal, not revenue; rounded to 2 significant figures.
methods.competitors: count of registry listings tagged with the keyword (city/national) or with the base service in the same state (state keywords)

auction_rules.pricing_rule: tier minimum (premium $500, high $250, mid $100, standard $50) for national keywords; city = max($10, 20% of tier); state = max($10, 35% of tier); spots 2-4 open at 10% of the featured minimum
auction_rules.model: Monthly auction in the last 7 days of each month: days 1-5 bid for the Featured #1 spot, days 6-7 for spots 2-4; winners display all next month; all paid spots labeled Sponsored.
